title: Snipe buy minOut when the price quote fails

options.name: Keep current behaviour: on a quote failure send the buy with amountOutMin = 0
options.risk: The buy executes at any price; during a busy launch block that can be far above the price the bot saw (bounded by the snipe amount). A fractional slippage value would silently hit the same path.

options.name: Skip the snipe when the quote fails
options.behavior_impact: No buy without a slippage floor; some opportunities are missed on an RPC blip.
options.risk: Missed snipes when the RPC is unreliable.

options.name: Retry the quote once or twice within a short budget, then skip
options.behavior_impact: Fewer missed snipes than fail-closed; still never buys without a floor.
options.risk: Adds latency to the buy; the retries need their own timeout.

options.name: Fall back to a floor derived from the honeypot roundtrip result
options.behavior_impact: Buys still go out with some floor when the router quote fails.
options.risk: The roundtrip does not return an expected output today, so this needs new plumbing and its floor may be stale.

recommendation: fail-closed (research recommendation), with the slippage math moved to integer basis points so no configuration can throw into the zero-floor path. The deliberate private leg's documented 0 floor (bot.ts:527-543) is a separate, intentional choice and is not decided by this card unless the operator wants it included.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S0/S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether the bot ever sends a snipe with no minimum output.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
